data.split: first 60% / next 20% / final 20% of source order

model_selection.selection_rule: highest validation AUC, then lowest validation Brier

capacity_kpi.name: positive response capture
capacity_kpi.numerator: observed responders inside the selected review tier
capacity_kpi.denominator: all observed responders in the evaluation split

capacity_decision.dependence_design: Every capacity option is evaluated on the same block-resampled replicate, preserving shared campaign or calendar shocks and the cross-option dependence required for probability-best estimates.
capacity_decision.question: Which review-capacity tier should advance to a randomized campaign test?
capacity_decision.constraint: contact review capacity cannot exceed 20% in the scenario set
capacity_decision.source_of_weights: repository-author exploratory trade-off register; no bank approval
reversal_conditions: A randomized test shows no incremental response lift.
Contact costs or customer-burden constraints dominate observed response concentration.
Performance degrades on a true dated out-of-period sample.

leakage_control: Call duration is excluded because it is only known after contact.
claim_boundary: Response prediction on observational campaign records is not an estimate of causal lift, profit, or customer lifetime value.
segment_and_horizon_boundary: Contact-channel diagnostics are reported, but the source has no long-term value, retention, cannibalization, or brand outcome. Short-term response concentration cannot substitute for them.

provenance.citation: Moro, S., Rita, P., & Cortez, P. (2014). Bank Marketing [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5K306
